senses.gloss: the law-giver, often <he>מ׳ רַבֵּינוּ</he> M. our teacher.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:1:4">Y. Taan. IV, beg. 67ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מ׳ דאנא וכ׳</he> by Moses, I will look (at the priests) and not be diverted.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 4:1:9">Y. Dem. IV, 24ᵃ</cite> top <he>בדֵין הוא מימר מ׳ דאנא וכ׳</he> will he (R. Ḥaggai) in this case, too, say, by Moses, I know the reason? Said he, by M. &c.; a. fr.—
Bets. 38ᵇ מ׳ שפיר קאמרית by Moses, art thou right? (Rashi).—Trnsf. great scholar (that thou art)!, (mostly ironically).
<cite ref="Shabbat 101b:3">Sabb. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ שפיר קאמרת</he> great scholar, art thou really right?; Bets. l. c. (v. supra); a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 174b:9">B. Bath. 174ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ בר עצרי</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="P01112"><he>עצורי</he></cite>); <cite ref="Arakhin 23a:36">Arakh. 23ᵃ</cite>
